module.title: React Fundamentals
module.description: Learn how modern frontend applications are built using React and component-based architecture.
learningObjectives: Learn how modern frontend apps work

lessons.title: What Is React?

definition.title: Simple Definition
definition.content: React is a JavaScript library used to build modern interactive user interfaces.

sections.heading: Why React Exists
sections.content: As websites became larger and more interactive, managing HTML and JavaScript manually became difficult. React simplifies frontend development.

sections.heading: Modern Websites Need React
sections.content: Applications like Instagram, Netflix, and Facebook constantly update content dynamically, which React handles efficiently.

sections.heading: React Focuses On Components
sections.content: React breaks websites into reusable pieces called components.

sections.heading: React Updates UI Efficiently
sections.content: React updates only necessary parts of the webpage instead of reloading the entire page.

easyExample.title: LEGO Example
easyExample.content: React works like LEGO blocks where small reusable pieces combine together to build large applications.

summary: Most modern frontend apps use React

lessons.title: What Are Components?

definition.title: Simple Definition
definition.content: Components are reusable pieces of UI in React.

sections.heading: Why Components Matter
sections.content: Large websites become easier to manage when broken into smaller reusable parts.

sections.heading: Reusable UI
sections.content: A single component can be reused multiple times across an application.

sections.heading: Independent Structure
sections.content: Each component manages its own structure, design, and logic.

sections.heading: Real World Usage
sections.content: Navbar, sidebar, buttons, cards, and forms are usually built as components.

easyExample.title: Car Parts Example
easyExample.content: A car is made using reusable parts like wheels, doors, and seats. React apps are built similarly using components.

basicCode.title: Button Component Example
explanation: Component can be reused multiple times

summary: Modern frontend apps rely on components

definition.title: Simple Definition
definition.content: JSX allows developers to write HTML-like code inside JavaScript.

sections.heading: Why JSX Exists
sections.content: JSX makes React code easier to read and write compared to pure JavaScript UI creation.

sections.heading: HTML Inside JavaScript
sections.content: JSX looks similar to HTML but works inside JavaScript files.

sections.heading: React Converts JSX
sections.content: React internally converts JSX into JavaScript code understood by browsers.

sections.heading: Modern React Uses JSX
sections.content: Most React applications are built using JSX syntax.

easyExample.title: Blueprint Example
easyExample.content: JSX works like a visual blueprint making UI easier to understand before construction.

definition.title: Simple Definition
definition.content: Props allow data to pass from one component to another.

sections.heading: Why Props Exist
sections.content: Components need a way to share and receive information.

sections.heading: Reusable Components Need Data
sections.content: A reusable component becomes more useful when different data can be passed into it.

sections.heading: Parent And Child Components
sections.content: Parent components send props to child components.

sections.heading: Props Improve Flexibility
sections.content: The same component can display different content using props.

easyExample.title: Food Delivery Example
easyExample.content: A delivery box can carry different food items. Props carry different data into components.

definition.title: Simple Definition
definition.content: State stores changing data inside components.

sections.heading: Why State Exists
sections.content: Web applications constantly change data like counters, themes, notifications, and forms.

sections.heading: Dynamic Data
sections.content: State allows React components to update automatically when data changes.

sections.heading: UI Reacts To State
sections.content: Whenever state changes, React updates the UI automatically.

sections.heading: Interactive Applications Depend On State
sections.content: Dark mode, carts, chats, dashboards, and login systems all use state heavily.

easyExample.title: Scoreboard Example
easyExample.content: A scoreboard changes dynamically during a match. State works similarly inside applications.

definition.title: Simple Definition
definition.content: React applications are built using reusable components connected together.

sections.heading: Applications As Component Trees
sections.content: React applications are structured like trees where components contain smaller child components.

sections.heading: Data Flow
sections.content: Props move data between components while state manages changing information.

sections.heading: Why React Became Popular
sections.content: React makes large frontend applications easier to manage and scale.

sections.heading: React In Real Companies
sections.content: Most major tech companies use React for modern frontend development.

easyExample.title: Company Structure Example
easyExample.content: A company has departments and teams working together. React applications work similarly using connected components.

basicCode.title: App Component Example
explanation: React builds UI using component trees
